file_change.purpose: Provide the minimum governed semantic-review surface needed for Design readiness, Planning acceptance, Build fidelity, bootstrap review evidence, and successor-cycle operation.
implementation: Define AssuranceFinding and AssuranceReport records with phase, governed subject identity, disposition, rationale, and evidence references.
Support Design, Planning, and Build review phases without encoding the full mature review-obligation/case/finding correspondence architecture.
Require a governed semantic review result before an acceptance gate when the applicable Core requirement requires Assurance.
Keep Assurance case-specific and non-authoritative: findings do not mutate normative authority and persistent meaning defects route to Design while Planning-intent defects route to Planning.

For FS0 bootstrap, consume externally produced Design and Planning Assurance evidence over the selected Design revisions, functional set, and resolved logical Plan without candidate-runtime self-authorization.
For successor functional sets, expose maintained Core capability to record and evaluate Design, Planning, and Build semantic review results.
Leave detailed Assurance rubrics, canonical per-requirement review-obligation correspondence, mature case/finding registries, and generalized evidence orchestration to later functional sets.
